chunks.text: Macpower CNC Machines Ltd - FY2024 Annual Report (Directors' Report excerpt) Business overview. The company is a BSE-listed SME in Capital Goods (scrip 543763). Standalone revenue for the latest reported year was approximately Rs 145.0 crore. Operations remain concentrated in India, with a mix of domestic OEM/institutional demand and limited exports. Performance and outlook. Year-on-year revenue growth was about 18.5%. Management guided for continued volume growth and a measured capex plan. Capacity utilization and order-book conversion were cited as the main near-term drivers. The Board's stated priorities for the next fiscal year are capital allocation, working-capital turns, and product-mix improvement. Key business risks. Material risks disclosed by management include: (1) raw-material and commodity price volatility in Capital Goods; (2) working-capital cycles and receivable delays from institutional customers; (3) regulatory and compliance changes applicable to listed SMEs; (4) customer concentration in a small number of accounts; and (5) FX and input-cost pass-through lag on export orders. The balance sheet is conservatively geared, with debt/equity below 1.0x. Governance. Auditors issued an unmodified opinion on the standalone financial statements. Related-party transactions and contingent liabilities are disclosed in the notes to accounts.
